name: MLLM-Guided Transfer Function Optimization
definition: Evaluation aspects include: (1) Information richness (visible features, suppressed noise), (2) Feature discrimination (extraction of different structural features), (3) Color harmony (aesthetic preferences), (4) Text intent alignment (textual consistency and visual quality), and (5) Visual intent alignment (color style matching and structural style matching against reference images).
summary: MLLM-Guided Transfer Function Optimization uses a multimodal large language model to evaluate and rank transfer functions via pairwise comparisons, converting subjective user intent into quantitative fitness scores for evolutionary optimization.
